notes: The ASV's marginal alternative (*which he shall take away by the kidneys*) is not the text aligned; the printed reading governs.
All four object markers are unrepresented, the objects being written bare, and the final object suffix goes unrendered, the object standing fronted.
The article on הַכְּלָיֹת takes the written *the* that English fronts before the numeral (rules 15, 29).
